title: This rug is thick and the colors are nice
text: This rug is thick and the colors are nice. This is a nice thick rug.  It doesn't have any backing so it might slip indoors. It's pretty. I'm using it as a table cover for my bistro set.  It looks cute with the fall pillows, I have on my chairs.  Washes easily.
